description: Header file defining a fixed-capacity, variable-sized vector container 'static_vector' with internal storage optimization for trivial and non-trivial types, including storage management, constructors, assignment, and modification methods.

classes.name: static_vector
classes.description: A fixed-capacity, variable-sized container with internal storage, similar to std::vector but with maximum size limited at compile time.

methods.name: emplace_back
methods.description: Constructs an element at the end of the vector with provided arguments.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds a copy or move of an element at the end of the vector.

methods.name: pop_back
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the vector.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the vector to a new size, constructing or destroying elements as needed.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns new contents to the vector from a range or initializer list.
